## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The code change is correct. `DEFAULT_TIMEOUT = 60` reaches `--timeout` through `default=DEFAULT_TIMEOUT`, and an explicit `--timeout` still overrides it. The README now gives the old default, which leaves users with the wrong number.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/cli.py:3 — comments — After `DEFAULT_TIMEOUT = 60`, the stale line at README.md:3 still says "Requests time out after 30 seconds unless you pass `--timeout SECONDS`." Please change it to 60 seconds in this PR. — A user who reads the README and runs without `--timeout` will expect a 30-second cutoff and get 60. Someone who tunes calls or retries against slow upstreams will rely on the wrong number.

## Suggestions
(none)

## Strengths
- `tests/test_cli.py:6-9` (`test_defaults`) now asserts `args.timeout == 60` with no arguments, so it would fail if the default stayed at 30.
- `tests/test_cli.py:13-16` (`test_explicit_options`) still checks that `--timeout 12` overrides the default. That covers the PR's claim that an explicit `--timeout` still takes precedence.
